remarks: Spacious two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath residence in the heart of downtown Stamford, offered at a price that reflects its potential. The open floor plan is generously proportioned and highly versatile, with ample room to relax, entertain, and work from home, while the solid layout and scale of the rooms present a rare opportunity to add real value through new flooring and a kitchen tailored entirely to your own taste. Common charges include heat, water, and cooking gas, along with front desk concierge service, a fitness center with sauna, and a seasonal outdoor pool; laundry is conveniently located on every floor. Shops, restaurants, and entertainment sit just steps from the door, with the Stamford Transportation Center and I-95 nearby for an effortless commute. For the buyer seeking an entry point into one of Fairfield County's most dynamic downtowns - with the opportunity to build equity through thoughtful updates - this is a compelling proposition.
